findings.detail: The slot point 4.2-K1 says few-shot examples are the most effective technique when detailed instructions alone give inconsistent output. The stem already states that this technique is chosen, so the question never tests that knowledge. No option compares few-shot prompting with another technique. Instead, the options test how to compose the example set: the 2-4 count (4.2-S1), showing the full format (4.2-S2) and generalization (4.2-K3).

blind_answer.reason: Two to four targeted examples covering different kinds of findings let the model generalize the format rather than match listed cases (4.2-K3, 4.2-S1). Each example should be a complete comment showing location, issue, severity and suggested fix in the exact format, which gives consistency (4.2-S2). C undermines consistency, D omits the very fields that are missing, and E encourages case-matching over generalization.
